legacy_php_vulnerabilities: SQL Injection via dynamic string interpolation (mysql_query, PDO string concatenation)
Lack of transaction rollback on unhandled PHP runtime exceptions
lts_data_layer_defenses: Strict prepared statements with parameterized positional or named bindings
Compile-time / runtime input validation preceding SQL generation
Foreign key constraint enforcement and WAL mode persistence
Zero dynamic string execution / zero eval

cutover_milestones: 1. Deploy modern LTS database schema alongside legacy schema
2. Enable shadow dual-writes: writes execute to both backends asynchronously
3. Enable shadow dual-reads: compare responses for 0% data drift
4. Promote LTS data layer to primary and sever legacy PHP database connection

artifacts.role: Type-safe database service with prepared statements
SQL Injection resistance and shadow consistency test suite
